mainEntity.name: What should homeowners prepare before consulting on an in-law suite addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before booking an initial consultation, compile a clear list of daily household needs and property details. Identify who will occupy the space, whether mobility equipment must be accommodated, and whether independent exterior access or private cooking amenities are required. It is also helpful to have your property survey on hand to review boundary setbacks and note the current location of your electrical panel and plumbing lines. Having this information ready streamlines initial feasibility assessments.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather your property survey, identify accessibility and privacy requirements, and decide whether the space needs a private entrance, kitchenette, or specialized bath fixtures.
